texts:
Wednesday's practice reports, team by team: two quarterbacks back on the field, a new starter in New York and a back ruled out for Thursday night.

Lamar Jackson

Baker Mayfield

J.J. McCarthy
#RavensFlock #GoBucs #NYGiants

Lamar Jackson was limited Wednesday, his first practice since the Week 4 ankle sprain. Jesse Minter calls it day to day, and Tyler Huntley starts vs CIN if he sits.

QB21 for me this week, a streamer until he practices in full. Monitor Friday's report.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Baker Mayfield practiced in full Wednesday for the first time since dislocating his right thumb in Week 3. Todd Bowles decides Friday whether he or Jalon Daniels starts in Carolina.

Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's decision.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Bucky Irving missed practice Wednesday with an illness. RB13 for me this week, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor Thursday's report.

Emeka Egbuka sat with a concussion and a foot injury. WR27 for me, a high-end WR3, only if he clears the protocol by Friday.
#GoBucs

Kyle Monangai is out Thursday vs New England, his third straight game missed with the thumb and toe. RB29 rest of season for me; hold him.

D'Andre Swift leads the Chicago backfield again, RB10 for me this week.
#DaBears #NEPats

Jordan Mason practiced in full Wednesday as his IR window opened. Once Minnesota activates him he takes the early downs vs IND, RB29 for me, a high-end RB3.

Aaron Jones Sr. is RB16 for me this week, an RB2.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Justin Jefferson was limited Wednesday with the ankle, a maintenance day.

WR11 for me this week vs IND, borderline WR1/WR2. Monitor Friday's report.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

John Harbaugh named J.J. McCarthy the Giants' starter at Houston over Jameis Winston.

McCarthy threw for 243 yards, a TD and a pick in relief vs NO, mostly down 34-10. Outside my top 12; monitor his first start before a superflex add.
#NYGiants #HTownMade #Saints

David Montgomery missed practice Wednesday with the groin, still week to week with Houston's bye next. RB21 rest of season for me; monitor Friday's report.

Woody Marks played 78 percent of the snaps in Week 6. RB20 for me vs the Giants, an RB2.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Tank Dell practiced in full Wednesday ahead of his first game since the 2024 knee injury. He plays the slot, so Jaylin Noel loses snaps first.

Monitor Dell's route share vs the Giants before you add him.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Breece Hall missed practice again Wednesday with the quad, and Aaron Glenn would not rule him out vs MIA. RB16 rest of season for me; monitor Friday's report.

Braelon Allen keeps the touches. RB12 for me this week, borderline RB1/RB2.
#JetUp #PhinsUp

Rashee Rice did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring, though Andy Reid says he is making progress. He also sat last Wednesday and Thursday.

WR20 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's report before Sunday in Seattle.
#ChiefsKingdom #Seahawks

Tyler Warren sat out Wednesday with the groin that cost him the Week 6 game vs TEN, when Keenan Allen drew 11 targets.

Warren is TE3 rest of season for me and outside my top 12 this week until he practices. Monitor Friday's report.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp

Mike Evans did not practice Wednesday with the Achilles tendinitis and is expected to miss Sunday in Atlanta, with San Francisco's bye after it.

WR26 rest of season for me. Hold him on your bench; Week 9 is the earliest return.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Christian Kirk is still on IR with the calf, but Kyle Shanahan calls him a possibility for Sunday with Evans out.

Add Kirk in 12-team leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#FTTB

Quinshon Judkins was limited Wednesday with the ankle after missing Week 6, and Todd Monken is optimistic he plays in Tennessee.

RB20 rest of season for me, outside my top 40 backs this week until he practices in full. Monitor Friday's report.
#DawgPound #TitanUp

Jordan Love was limited Wednesday with the back. QB3 for me this week in Detroit; monitor Friday's report.

Matt LaFleur has not committed to Josh Jacobs playing Week 7. RB17 for me this week, an RB2; monitor Friday's report.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Jordyn Tyson won't practice this week with the hamstring, per Mickey Loomis, and New Orleans has its bye after Sunday vs PIT in Paris.

WR55 rest of season for me; hold him in an IR spot.
#Saints #HereWeGo

Every note from Wednesday is on the Pass, with Thursday's lineup calls next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Friday's injury read, and like this if it helps your lineup.
